name: Peld
title: Ferryman
examine: Pond-water calm. His hands only look idle — they know every current in the millpond by name.
lines: P-pond's quiet today. Best kind of day.
I walked up from Saltmere country when I was small. One day I'll pole somebody all the way back down. The river remembers the way even if nobody else does.
Garton grumbles about my bell. He also checks the pond every morning to make sure I'm on it. Don't tell him I noticed.
